## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive. SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND and credit stress rising: HYG (1W: -0.61% | 1M: -1.54%) BELOW TREND and LQD (1W: -1.81% | 1M: -1.95%) BELOW TREND — two independent confirmations alongside weak breadth.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Fear rising: VIX (1W: +8.74% | 1M: +21.92%) ↑ rising ABOVE TREND while VXX (1W: -1.60% | 1M: +29.42%) CORRECTION signals a short-term volatility divergence. Credit stress ↑ (Credit Spread Level 0.7322, 1W: +1.21% ↑ rising) with HY/IG under pressure.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Dollar strength and higher yields tightening conditions: UUP (proxy) (1W: +1.57% | 1M: +3.99%) ABOVE TREND and TLT (1W: -2.17% | 1M: -1.40%) BELOW TREND — liquidity and duration preference weakening.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Defensive/commodity leadership: XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND; broad cyclical/financial pressure with XLF (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -9.44%) BELOW TREND and XLK (1W: -0.36% | 1M: -4.32%) BELOW TREND — style: mixed, defensives showing relative strength.

**5. US vs Global?**
US equities weak: SPY (1W: -1.50% | 1M: -4.29%) BELOW TREND and small caps IWM (1W: -1.71% | 1M: -6.93%) BELOW TREND; China FXI (1W: +1.17% | 1M: -8.18%) RECOVERY but EM (EEM (1W: -0.91% | 1M: -7.73%) BELOW TREND) remains pressured.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculative pockets mixed: IBIT (1W: +4.59% | 1M: +5.43%) ABOVE TREND showing crypto inflows while ARKK (1W: -2.97% | 1M: -0.87%) BELOW TREND and IWM BELOW TREND signal risk aversion; Speculation Index (1W: -3.16% | 1M: +5.57%) ↓ falling.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Oil-led commodity surge: USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND; copper CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND — divergence between energy and industrial metals.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy strong: XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND driving sector breadth; natural gas UNG (1W: -0.86% | 1M: +2.60%) CORRECTION shows mixed fuel dynamics.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Credit and equity downside — HYG and LQD BOTH BELOW TREND and SPY/TLT both showing downside pressure. DIVERGENCE: VXX 1W down vs VIX materially up and IBIT ABOVE TREND — watch volatility vs realized flows.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Risk-OFF posture: favor defensive exposures showing strength (XLU (1W: +0.27% | 1M: +5.80%) ABOVE TREND) and commodity/energy plays (XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND); reduce exposure to broad growth cyclicals (SPY, QQQ, IWM all BELOW TREND).

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: Energy — XLE (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +4.95%) ABOVE TREND if oil (USO (1W: +10.22% | 1M: +51.97%) ABOVE TREND) momentum continues. BEARISH: Financials/Industrials — XLF (1W: -3.13% | 1M: -9.44%) BELOW TREND and XLI/industrials under pressure.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: Crude — BNO (1W: +11.58% | 1M: +49.06%) ABOVE TREND and USO ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper/industrial metals — CPER (1W: -2.27% | 1M: -5.38%) BELOW TREND.

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (watch volatility complacency) with VIX elevated (1W: +8.74% | 1M: +21.92%) ↑ rising; HYG/LQD ratio ~0.73 (credit health); XLK/XLF 2.7981 (1W: +0.77% | 1M: +3.90%) ABOVE TREND as style pivot metric.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF. Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive, with credit stress rising (HYG/LQD) and equities (SPY) BELOW TREND. XLU and XLE showing relative strength while VIX/VXX divergence and rising credit spreads are the key risks to monitor.
